comment: Claude dialogs, model picker details, and startup banner.

SETTINGS_TABS.comment: Find the Settings dialog tab row.

PANEL_CLOSE.comment: Find the close or cancel hint of a Claude panel.

PLAN_MENU_OPTION.comment: Find a plan chooser option that keeps the plan open.

MODEL_MORE.comment: Read the number of hidden Claude model rows.

MODEL_EFFORT.comment: Read the level on the Claude effort slider.

PERMISSIONS_TAB_ROW.comment: Read the first tab after the Permissions heading.

PERMISSIONS_HINT.comment: Find the Permissions dialog footer hint.

BANNER_START.comment: Find the Claude startup banner version row.

BANNER_END.comment: Find the first rule, prompt, or response after the Claude banner.

SIDE_RULE.comment: Find the top edge of the /btw side question overlay.

SIDE_QUESTION.comment: Read the question row of the /btw overlay.

SIDE_FOOTER.comment: Find the key hints that end the /btw overlay.

SIDE_COPY.comment: A finished /btw answer offers the copy key.

SIDE_FORK.comment: A finished /btw answer offers the fork key.
